title: Chapter 1: The Real Skill Of Escaping
content:
Chapter 1: The Real Skill Of Escaping

Wu Qing opened his eyes and found himself standing in a group of aliens.

There were cat-eared men, rabbit-eared men, fox-like men around him, and even more frighteningly, there were dog-headed men, pig-faced men, and rat-faced wretched men!

The reason why they were all men was because this was not a gentle place, but a battlefield of life and death!

It was a serious battlefield!

These strange-looking aliens wore linen clothes, holding spears, sticks and shields, and only a few had iron tools in their hands. They were a mob at first glance.

They lined up in a loose formation and were struggling to resist the crazy attack of a group of green-skinned people on the opposite side.

Wu Qing was standing in this team, wearing linen clothes and no armor, dressed similarly to the others.

He carried a bundle of wooden javelins on his back and had no weapons in his hands, like a porter.

Next to him were two strong dog-headed men who were taller than him, holding javelins and throwing them into the distance.

The scene was very chaotic, and there was an unpleasant smell mixed with sweat all around, which made people want to vomit!

"My strength is gone!"

Wu Qing felt the pressure of the javelin on his back, and he found that all his strength had disappeared, and now he became an ordinary person.

The situation was unclear at this time, and he did not dare to act rashly.

Unfortunately, the battlefield situation changed rapidly, and Wu Qing did not have time to adapt, and his own defense line collapsed!

Wu Qing was only 1.8 meters tall, and he was short among this group of aliens, and he could not see the specific situation in front of him at all.

When two sides fought and one side collapsed, it was the beginning of a unilateral massacre.

Although Wu Qing had lost all his strength, he had good physical fitness and combat experience.

Wu Qing carried the javelin on his back and cleverly used his actions to guide the people around him who were fleeing to the forest on one side of the battlefield.

Behind him were crazy shouts and shrill screams.

A massacre was going on.

In order not to stand out too much and attract attention, Wu Qing had been mixed in the crowd, which affected his speed, and they were soon caught up by a group of green-skinned people.

These green-skinned people are a bit like the legendary goblins, but they are tall and strong. They can walk fast with thick sticks and easily catch up with the group of people around Wu Qing.

"God of the Spirit! Give me strength!"

The green-skinned people shouted slogans fanatically and launched a charge.

The group of foreigners around Wu Qing had no intention of fighting and were scared out of their wits. They were terrified and took out their strength to run away in all directions.

"I met a pig teammate!"

Wu Qing lamented in his heart.

He saw a real "pig" teammate, whose fat pig head was hit by a green-skinned person.

It would be difficult to escape the fate of being slaughtered by the enemy one by one if there was no organization in the battlefield.

Wu Qing had no choice but to run for his life alone.

He sped up and ran towards the forest. He found that the green-skinned people who shouted slogans seemed to be getting faster and faster. There were also a few green-skinned people riding large lizards, and their speed was even faster.

After some calculation, Wu Qing found that if he just ran like this, he would be caught up before he could reach the forest. In this open space, if he was entangled, the result would not be good.

Wu Qing thought about it, suddenly stopped, threw the javelin on his back to the ground, pulled out a javelin, and threw it at a green-skinned man riding a lizard and dressed slightly differently in a very standard posture.

He judged that this green-skinned man should be the commander of the enemy team chasing him.

To capture a thief, you must first capture the leader, and to kill an enemy, you must first kill the general!

The javelin drew a perfect arc, accurately predicted the position of the target, and nailed the green-skinned man guarded by several green-skinned knights on the back of the lizard.

"Javelin, I'm a professional!"

Wu Qing was very confident in his javelin throwing skills. He threw nine more javelin throwings in a row, and each javelin hit the target, nailing all the green-skinned men closest to him to the ground.

His magical javelin throwing skills temporarily shocked the pursuing enemies and bought him some time.

He picked up the remaining two javelins with a bit of exhaustion and ran towards the forest without looking back.

Wu Qing's actions seemed to have stirred up a hornet's nest. With loud shouts, more greenskins rushed in this direction.

Wu Qing knew that his behavior would attract key targets, but if he didn't do this, he might not be able to escape the forest.

"Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh...!"

The whistling sound of stones sounded beside Wu Qing, and several stones hit the ground heavily, turning up the grass and flying the soil.

These were stones thrown by the greenskins riding on the big lizards with slingshots.

Wu Qing ran with his head down, running faster and faster, and the potential of his whole body seemed to be stimulated.

Behind him, several cavalrymen led a large group of greenskins to chase him frantically.

Listening to the wind and determining the position, Wu Qing dodged several more stone attacks and finally rushed into the lush forest before being caught up.

Don't enter the forest. This military common sense doesn't seem to apply here.

Wu Qing's wave of spear attacks made the greenskins want to drink his blood and eat his flesh!

The greenskins chasing him rushed into the jungle without hesitation.

Wu Qing felt relieved after entering the forest. While running, he casually set up some obstacles in the forest to interfere and slow down the enemy's pursuit.

He did not run in one direction, but kept running in different directions, making noise, alarming the animals in the forest, and creating an illusion.

He did this to disperse the pursuers.

Wu Qing found that in the forest, the greenskins seemed to be at home, very familiar with fighting in the forest, and could accurately track his traces.

Without some tricks, it would be difficult for him to get rid of these pursuers by just running away.

As he went deeper into the forest, Wu Qing's tricks worked. There was only a three-man team chasing him, and the other greenskins were scattered at a certain distance.

Three tall greenskins, bare-chested, carrying thick sticks, moved agilely and quickly in the forest.

Suddenly, a short spear flew out from the forest next to him and pierced the neck of the leading greenskin.

The greenskin groaned and fell to the ground.

A figure as swift as a leopard followed closely, and the short spear in his hand stabbed the second greenskin's lower road, causing the second greenskin to crouch down for protection.

The short spear was like a dragon emerging from the water, suddenly stabbing upwards and piercing the second greenskin's throat!

This figure was Wu Qing, and he fought back!

The last greenskin shouted and swung a big stick at Wu Qing. Wu Qing was agile and dodged the big stick. When the greenskin hit him with a stick and changed his moves, he stabbed the greenskin under the armpit with a spear, piercing his heart!

Wu Qing loosened the javelin that he used as a short melee spear stuck in the greenskin’s chest and retreated from the forest.

The three greenskins were hit in the vitals and died after struggling for a while.

Wu Qing left calmly.

He didn’t see that when the three greenskins he killed died, their bodies quickly weathered, and their real bodies seemed to become illusory images, which disappeared with the wind in a flash.

Only three big sticks and two javelin were left on the spot, as well as a few pieces of animal skins.

In fact, this happened when he killed the greenskin for the first time with a javelin, but he was busy running for his life and didn’t see it.

This is also one of the reasons why the greenskins must chase him.

Wu Qing used his skilled jungle combat experience to counterattack several times and killed many green-skinned people.

But the number of green-skinned people searching and chasing him in the forest did not decrease, but increased, as if they had to catch him.

"Did I kill a great person?"

Wu Qing secretly lamented his bad luck. He fought and retreated, and with his current physique, he also felt tired.

After a difficult section of the road, Wu Qing used the environment to create several large traps and obstacles, which could temporarily block the green-skinned people who were chasing for a while.

In front of him was a valley that was easy to defend and difficult to attack. Unfortunately, Wu Qing was alone now and could not defend the mountain pass.

Finally, he had a little buffer time. He found a hidden place to sit down and rest, calling the system in his heart.

He was once an ordinary otaku on Earth. He was struck by lightning while playing games on a rainy day and traveled to another world. Relying on the game base system he obtained, he fought all the way and finally unified the entire other world.

The ascent path of the other world was cut off. He did not want to be trapped in one world, so he resolutely stepped into the one-way wormhole and came to this world.

"My strength is gone, and the system functions are also restricted."

Wu Qing guessed that the system should have undergone unknown changes during his passage through the wormhole.

He silently turned on the system, and the original operating interface of the system disappeared, leaving only a long row of prompt messages.

[The controller enters the universe. ]

[Rejected by the will of the universe, the emergency procedure is activated. ]

[Consume the controller's strength, improve the controller's potential qualifications, and eliminate the controller's alien mark. ]

[Integrate the world controlled by the controller and generate the system's affiliated world. ]

[The system's affiliated world is hidden. ]

[Consume the luck of the system's affiliated world and generate the StarCraft game base. ]

[The system is hidden. ]

[The material-energy conversion function is turned on. ]

[Kill the enemy, and the cause and effect relationship is established. ]

[Material-energy conversion, gain 25 energy points and 5 qi points. ]

[Material-energy conversion,...]
